    apos = [100,80,60,40,20,0]  # reversed abs distances descending
    for i in range(len(apos)-1):
        hi = apos[i]; lo = apos[i+1]
        if z <= hi and z >= lo:
            # value at hi and lo
            vhi = vals[zs.index(-hi)] if -hi in zs else vals[zs.index(hi)]
            vlo = vals[zs.index(-lo)] if -lo in zs else vals[zs.index(lo)]
            return vlo + (vhi - vlo)*(z - lo)/(hi - lo)
    return vals[5]  # 0

def dft(y, Q, v, p, margin):
    scale = (Q/v)/(300/400.0)
    total = 0.0
    y0 = -margin
    ymax = 700 + margin
    y_line = y0
    while y_line <= ymax + 1e-9:
        total += profile(y - y_line)
        y_line += p
    return scale * total

for p in [30,35,40,45,50]:
    for margin in [50,80,100]:
        s = dft(350, 300, 400, p, margin)
        b = dft(30, 300, 400, p, margin)
        t = dft(670, 300, 400, p, margin)
        print(f"p={p} m={margin}: center={s:.0f} bottom={b:.0f} top={t:.0f}")
